commentDescription.message: Save a comment to post and pin automatically.

commentPlaceholder.message: Everyone is welcome! Say hello in chat.

commentCategoryHint.message: Leave blank to use the default. The category on Twitch at posting time is used. Apply edits with Save settings.

commentAutoPost.message: Post once when a stream starts

commentDetails.message: While Chrome is running, only the stream status is checked about once a minute. If you enable this during a live stream, it posts once for that stream too. Pinning replaces the current pin. In Shared Chat, the comment is also sent to the shared channels.

loginReauthorizePrompt.message: Log in again to enable chat posting and pinning. Your saved settings will be kept.

commentUnsaved.message: Unsaved changes — use Save settings to apply.

commentWaiting.message: No delivery recorded yet. Automatic posting is off unless enabled above.

commentOffline.message: Offline. The comment will be posted when a live stream is detected if automatic posting is enabled.

commentSent.message: Posted for this stream. It will not be posted again.

commentPinned.message: Posted and pinned for this stream. It will not be posted again after the pin expires or is removed.

commentSendFailed.message: Not posted. Check the error, then use Post now / retry. No automatic resend will be attempted for this stream.

commentPinFailed.message: The comment was posted, but pinning failed. Post now / retry retries only the pin with the original duration.

commentDeliveryUnknown.message: Delivery could not be confirmed. To avoid duplicates, this stream will not be retried. Check Twitch chat and post or pin manually if needed.

commentPinInterrupted.message: Pinning was interrupted. Check Twitch, then retry the pin if needed.

errorCommentPermissions.message: Log in again and allow the requested access.

errorCommentAuthCheck.message: Could not check Twitch permissions. Try again later.

errorCommentStreamCheck.message: Could not check the live stream. No comment was posted.

errorCommentAccount.message: The saved comment belongs to a different login. Review the comment and save settings for this account before posting.

errorCommentLength.message: Each comment must be 500 characters or fewer.

errorCommentEmpty.message: No comment is set for this category. Save a default or category comment first.

errorCommentDropped.message: Twitch did not send the comment: $reason$

errorTitleTooLong.message: The expanded title is $count$ characters; the maximum is $max$.
errorTitleTooLong.description: Error when an expanded stream title exceeds the Twitch title limit.

analyticsSubtitle.message: Understand what brings people in, gets them talking, and brings them back.

analyticsPrivacy.message: Stored on this computer in IndexedDB. Chat text is never saved. Enabling requests chat-read and follower-read access. Closing Chrome, sleep, logout, and connection failures leave gaps.

analyticsComparison.message: Compared with the previous equal-length period. Average viewers is the mean of measured stream averages. Counts include observed events only; repeat commenters can appear in multiple streams.

analyticsNoHistory.message: No streams in this period. Enable Analytics to import available Twitch archives; viewer and chat metrics are collected from your next stream.

analyticsEmptyChart.message: No measured values for this period

analyticsNextStream.message: Viewer metrics are collected during future streams. VODs cannot restore past viewers or chatters.

analyticsFirstInfo.message: Users first observed commenting during a stream since Stream Helper measurement began. Silent viewers cannot be identified. Broadcasters and messages originating in other Shared Chat channels are excluded.

analyticsAcquisitionNote.message: Current followers as of the completed sync, grouped by followed_at. People who unfollowed are absent; this is not historical new-follow totals. Pagination is not an atomic Twitch snapshot.

analyticsCategoryNote.message: Grouped by the first category observed in each measured stream. Whole-stream metrics include subsequent category changes; they do not measure an individual category segment.

analyticsNoSavedStreams.message: No streams saved yet. Enable Analytics to see available Twitch history and future streams here.

analyticsNoRecap.message: Your first measured stream recap will appear here after it ends.

analyticsGoodAvg.message: Average viewers exceeded the previous-stream average.

analyticsGoodFirst.message: More first-time commenters than the previous-stream average.

analyticsGoodFollow.message: More follows observed than the previous-stream average.

analyticsReference.message: Viewer samples have gaps. Treat the average as a reference value.

analyticsEventWarning.message: Event coverage is incomplete or unknown. Comment, follow, and raid counts are observed minimums; missing time is not zero.

analyticsExportNote.message: Exports follow the selected period. Stream rows use start date; viewer samples use sample time. Missing values stay blank. No viewer identities are exported.

analyticsEndObserved.message: End time is the first offline poll, bounded by the last live check and the offline check. Duration and coverage are approximate.

analyticsEndUnknown.message: The end occurred while collection was unavailable. End time, duration, and coverage remain unknown unless a matching archive becomes available.

analyticsBounds.message: Last live check → first offline check

analyticsHistoryNote.message: History begins when observed. A VOD title is one archive title, not every title used during that stream.

analyticsLabelsInfo.message: Private labels for analysis, separate from Twitch tags.

analyticsCompareTen.message: Compared with up to 10 preceding measured, completed streams

analyticsFollowNote.message: Observed follows only. Blank days have no confirmed coverage; lines and bars do not fill gaps. Boundary events remain uncertain until stream observations or an archive resolve them.

analyticsBackfillComplete.message: Available Twitch history imported and kept locally

analyticsBackfillPending.message: History sync will start after enabling Analytics

analyticsStatusDisconnected.message: EventSub reconnect pending; chat, follow, raid and other events may be missing

analyticsPollPending.message: No successful stream check recorded yet

analyticsPollStale.message: No successful stream check within the last 3 minutes. Streams and viewer counts may not be recorded. Check authorization and connectivity; reload the extension if the problem continues.

analyticsStatusError.message: Some data could not be collected. Collection will retry on a later poll.

analyticsStatusAuth.message: Authorization required. Use Enable Analytics / authorize to sign in again.

analyticsStatusRate.message: Twitch rate limit reached. Collection will wait before retrying.

analyticsFetchError.message: Could not read Twitch analytics data.

analyticsPermissions.message: Analytics needs follower-read and chat-read permission. Authorize Analytics again.

analyticsDbBlocked.message: Close other Analytics tabs and reload to upgrade the local database.

analyticsLocalError.message: The local operation failed. Check available disk space, then refresh this page.

analyticsRetentionNote.message: Of the users first observed in the selected period, the number observed in another stream at any later recorded date. Recent cohorts have had less time to return.

analyticsBackfillMetrics.message: Archive metadata only · audience and event metrics were not measured

analyticsVodTimingNote.message: Recording length is separate from the observed broadcast duration; a VOD may contain only part of a stream.

analyticsLegacyChatOrigin.message: This stream includes comments recorded before Shared Chat filtering. Their original channels were not saved, so those comments cannot be separated retrospectively.
